name: Bookends
blurb: A pair of L-shaped bookends to keep books standing up on a shelf.

steps.text: Cut two bases and two uprights, each 6 inches long, from the 1x6.
On each base, mark two holes 3/8 inch from one end, spread across the middle.
Drill the holes through the base, then countersink them so the screw heads sit flush underneath.
Stand an upright on that end of the base and drill small pilot holes up into it through the holes.
Screw the upright on from underneath.
